what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Tunisia, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2023, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 2644 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Tunisia list storms and wildfires.
UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tunisia from 2013 to 2015 and with the Islamic State group in 2016.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2013.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Tunisia.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
